title: vektor /// no. 055 — Draw your whole codebase as a galaxy.
description: One prompt in Claude Code (VS Code extension, Opus 5.5, auto mode) cloned microsoft/vscode at commit 13de456, src/ only, and wrote repo-map.html: one self-contained, offline, 1.34 MB HTML file. 11 modules rendered as star clusters, 10,022 files as stars sized by lines of code, 2,836,738 non-blank lines, 107,661 file-to-file imports (61,998 of them crossing module boundaries, collapsing to 32 module-to-module connection lines), the editor module alone holding 995 files. 30 minutes wall clock, zero follow-up messages. Every file gets a one-line, plain-English description generated by reading that file: 1,435 of 10,022 (14%) come from the authors' own code comments, the rest from what the code declares. Both prompts below: the exact one that ran, and a your-repo version, copy-paste ready.
